Subject: Intermittent 5xx / timeouts from Lynx-3B in production

Hi Sofia,

We started seeing elevated 5xx responses and client-side timeouts from the Lynx-3B model in our production workspace starting ~08:45 PDT. Error rate spiked to ~7% for a 20-minute window and then subsided, but we continue to see occasional timeouts (~1-2%). Example request IDs: req_3f9d2, req_3f9d8, req_3fa0f (timestamps included in attached app logs).

This is impacting our chat feature — customers hit a loading spinner. Can Redwood confirm whether this is a platform-level degradation or something on our side? Any ETA on a mitigation or recommended fallback model would be helpful.

Attaching our app logs for the 08:40–09:20 window.

Thanks,
Sofie

Subject: Re: Lynx-3B elevated 5xx / timeouts — internal RCA and recovery plan

Quick internal summary (triage notes):

What happened:
- Between 08:40–09:05 PDT Lynx-3B inference nodes experienced cascading request-processing slowdowns under mid-sized sequence loads (~1k–2k tokens) that surfaced as increased 5xx and client timeouts.
- Root cause appears to be a memory-accounting regression introduced in the quantized attention kernel (v2.3.7) that manifests when KV cache cleanups overlap with batched requests at sequence boundaries. The leak doesn't always trigger, which is why the spike was transient.

Immediate mitigations we performed:
- Rolled back the v2.3.7 kernel on the affected Lynx-3B pool and deployed v2.3.6 which eliminates the regression (hotfix completed at 09:40 PDT).
- Automated routing: we shifted accounts to the Lynx-3B-lite fallback during the spike (Sofia did this proactively).
- Scaled additional pre-warmed nodes and adjusted autoscaler thresholds to prevent the same burst from overwhelming individual nodes.

Customer-facing outcomes and next steps:
- Recovery: hotfix reduced 5xx to baseline by ~09:45 PDT; no further sustained spikes observed.
- Long-term: engineering will add a kernel-level unit test that reproduces the KV overlap case, and we will add a perf/regression gate to our CI for quantized kernels.
- Canaries: before the next kernel release we'll do a canary rollout restricted to non-production pools and run a 48-hour soak.

Attachments: lynx3b_rca.pdf (detailed timeline, traces, heap profiles) and lynx3b_mitigation_runbook.md (operator steps for future occurrences). Shared drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/lynx3b-rca

Action items (owners):
- Ben: Publish RCA and add CI regression test (ETA 2026-06-05).
- Marissa: Coordinate formal customer postmortem email and credits/compensation cadence with Finance (ETA 2026-06-03).
- Sofia: Share this summary with Starlight and confirm whether they want a credit request opened.

Ben Carter
